name: CHiSafetyBench
description: CHiSafetyBench is a Chinese hierarchical safety benchmark for large language models that evaluates their ability to identify risky content and refuse to answer risky questions. It covers a hierarchical taxonomy with 5 risk areas and 31 categories, using multiple-choice and question-answering tasks to assess safety capabilities in authentic Chinese scenarios.
reputation: A recent Chinese safety benchmark that has gained attention for hierarchical risk evaluation, especially for Chinese-language LLM safety assessment.
notes: Includes hierarchical taxonomy of safety risks; publicly available dataset; validates automatic evaluation as substitute for human evaluation.
